sloka: पपात स गदोद्भिन्नः परिघस्तस्य भूतले ।। ६.९८.२३ ।।ोषताम्राक्षः समुद्यम्य महाहवे।ततो जग्राह तेजस्वी सुग्रीवो वसुधातलात्।आयसं मुसलं घोरं सर्वतो हेमभूषितम् ।। ६.९८.२४ ।।
transliteration: papāta sa gadodbhinnaḥ parighastasya bhūtale ।। 6.98.23 ।।oṣatāmrākṣaḥ samudyamya mahāhave।tato jagrāha tejasvī sugrīvo vasudhātalāt।āyasaṁ musalaṁ ghoraṁ sarvato hemabhūṣitam ।। 6.98.24 ।।

translations.english: In that terrible conflict, seeing the mace broken and falling, mighty Sugriva, whose eyes turned red in anger, lifted up his iron bar, struck at the mace of the Rakshasa. The mace fell on the ground and broke into pieces.
